LESSON: GUIDED WRITING: SPELLING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Writing 3.1 Guided Writing: Handwriting (2 sessions) • Neatness and legibility •
Topic 3.2: Guided Writing: Spelling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing: Spelling, part of Writing 3.1 Guided Writing: Handwriting (2 sessions) • Neatness and legibility • in Grade 7 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: How can you ensure the correct spelling of words when writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. work jointly to list various professions on charts for display,

2. share their charts with peers for review on spelling,

3. work jointly to fill word puzzles on the various professions,

4. write sentences using the acquired vocabulary on the theme neatly and legibly,

5. reorganise jumbled up words to form meaningful sentences using correct spelling,

6. peer assess each other’s work for correct spelling, neatness, and legibility.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. work jointly to list various professions on charts for display,
2. share their charts with peers for review on spelling,
3. work jointly to fill word puzzles on the various professions,
4. write sentences using the acquired vocabulary on the theme neatly and legibly,
5. reorganise jumbled up words to form meaningful sentences using correct spelling,
6. peer assess each other’s work for correct spelling, neatness, and legibility.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing: Spelling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and Problem-solving: The learner explores a range of possible solutions and spelling when working

jointly to fill word puzzles on the various professions.
